title: Moving a skill file requires fixing its relative links and the .github/instructions pointers together
answers: I moved a skill file and links broke
why do relative links in SKILL.md point to ../../../
how do I rename the python-style or github-actions-style skill
what must change when relocating the style guide
body:
Skill files sit two directories deeper than the old .claude/rules files, so relative links must use ../../../ (for example ../../../.github/policy.rego and ../../../dev/clint/) rather than ../../.
When a skill path changes, update the matching .github/instructions/*.instructions.md link in the same change, since Copilot review reads those files for conventions.
Keep the applyTo scopes in the instructions files unchanged when moving the guidance; the scope lives in the instructions front matter, not in the skill.
The skill's name in frontmatter should match its directory name (python-style, github-actions-style).
applies: Any move, rename, or link edit to files under .claude/skills/ or .github/instructions/.
says: Moving our style guidelines broke relative links pointing to repository policies.
Automated code reviews cannot find coding conventions after moving assistant skill documents.
Relative links in relocated style guides lead to missing repository files.
Ensure instruction pointers match the new location when relocating coding guidelines.
Renaming a coding style guide causes broken documentation links in review settings.
search: Moving or renaming skill files under .claude/skills/ requires updating relative links to use ../../../ instead of ../../ because skills sit two directories deeper than legacy .claude/rules. Any path change to files like .claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md or .claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md must be updated together with matching pointers in .github/instructions/python.instructions.md or .github/instructions/github-actions.instructions.md for Copilot reviews. The applyTo scopes in instructions front matter must remain unchanged when moving guidance, and the skill name frontmatter must match its directory name.
